picks.title: Athenahealth launches tool to bring patient health records into Anthropic's Claude
picks.excerpt: EHR vendor athenahealth is opening patient health records to outside AI assistants, starting with Anthropic's Claude, so patients can ask questions about their own records.
picks.rationale: A concrete EHR launch that reaches patients directly: athenahealth opens patients' own records to an outside AI assistant (Claude first) so they can ask questions about their care. This is a different vendor and a different direction (patient-facing record export) from Suki's clinician 'Ask' (10-09) and Epic Connectors (10-22).

picks.title: Wearable devices + AI analysis may predict high blood pressure crisis up to 3 days early
picks.excerpt: AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 abstract: AI analysis of a cuff BP monitor plus fitness tracker flagged hypertensive crisis risk up to three days ahead; nocturnal patterns and morning surges were top predictors.
picks.rationale: A primary-source clinical abstract from AHA Scientific Sessions 2026. AI combining home cuff readings with fitness-tracker data flagged hypertensive-crisis risk up to three days early, an actionable early-warning result for patients and clinicians. No hypertension/wearable story is in the 30-day history, and the URL is absent from gadgets' published URLs. It is an abstract, so the copy should say 'may'.

picks.title: Governments across Europe and Central Asia unanimously adopt new vision for AI in health care
picks.excerpt: The 53 member states of WHO's European Region adopted a regional framework for safe, equitable AI in health systems.
picks.rationale: A regulator-level official decision: all 53 WHO European Region member states adopted a regional framework for AI in health systems. This is a different body and a different instrument from the 10-22 Korea MOHW-WHO Seoul Declaration. The URL is not in politics' published URLs.

picks.title: Large language models show product name convergence in drug recommendations
picks.excerpt: Across 123 disease-drug pairs and 1,440 sociodemographic profiles, five LLMs repeatedly converged on specific branded products when recommending treatment.
picks.rationale: A patient-safety and bias finding: across 123 disease-drug pairs and 1,440 patient profiles, five LLMs kept steering treatment recommendations toward specific branded products. This is new evidence on how AI medication advice can be skewed. It differs from the 10-17 NEJM AI cost-of-care study and the 10-30 Doximity dosing-error report (a different question and a different study).

picks.title: 용인세브란스병원, 흉부 엑스레이로 심장 기능 저하 예측 AI 개발
picks.excerpt: 용인세브란스병원 연구팀이 흉부 X선 영상만으로 좌심실 박출률 저하(심장 기능 저하)를 예측하는 AI 모델을 개발·검증했다.
picks.rationale: A diagnostic AI from a hospital team. It predicts reduced left-ventricular ejection fraction from a routine chest X-ray alone, which enables opportunistic heart-failure screening. This was yesterday's held-back runner-up. It uses a different modality and a different team from the 10-19 NEJM AI auscultation-LVD study and the 10-20 메디컬에이아이 ECG clearance.

dedup.note: DROPPED AS DUPLICATES / FOLLOW-UPS: (1) MedCity News '7 Potential Problems with Medicare's AI Prior Authorization Experiment'. This is analysis of the WISeR model already covered by the 10-30 JAMA card, with no new decision, so it is a follow-up without a new action. (2) STAT 'FDA, CMS scramble... state sandboxes'. This is behind-the-scenes reporting on the running state-sandbox story (10-07 Utah pilots, 10-15 lobbyists), with no new decision or release. It was also rejected on 11-02. (3) AuntMinnie SIIM-CAIMI 'AI platform maintains success in two pediatric imaging pipelines'. This is the same conference and likely the same pediatric-hospital pipeline program as the 10-29 SIIM-CAIMI pediatric LLM pipeline card, so it is too close to call new. (4) AuntMinnie SIIM-CAIMI Apollo LLM. A third SIIM-CAIMI card after 10-28 and 10-29; it was also rejected on 11-02. NOT PICKED (ranked lower): Nature Medicine EVLF-FM, a second medical VLM soon after the 10-13 open VLM. RapidAI+AZmed, a platform integration of already-cleared apps with no og_image. AHA non-expert rural echo, held back to keep AHA at 1 card (a good runner-up). MedPage ASRM ChatGPT-vs-IVF, a runner-up. npj fever prediction in cancer patients, a runner-up. Google Singapore health hub, a partnership announcement close to business noise. 숨빗AI conference interview, a talk and not a release. CROSS-SECTION: I read the politics, science and gadgets blocks of published_urls.json. None of the five pick URLs, nor athenahealth, WHO Europe, the AHA wearable or LLM brand-convergence stories, appear there. Marketing and other blocks were not fully scanned (Read-only, no grep), so the orchestrator should exact-grep the five URLs before roll. Diversity: 5 distinct outlets (Fierce Healthcare, AHA Newsroom, WHO Europe, Nature Health, 메디게이트뉴스) and 2 languages. No pathogen or biosecurity content.
